title: Conditions in Rules and Contracts
goal: Set conditions in rules and contracts with en caso de que, siempre y cuando, salvo que and con tal de que + subjunctive.

items: I can set a condition in a rule with *en caso de que*, *siempre y cuando*, *salvo que* and *con tal de que* + subjunctive.
I can say how notice is given with *previo aviso*, *por escrito* and *notificar*.
I can read a rule and find its condition and what depends on it.
